sales271.scope: Two real Cloud peers in the caller's empty Play fixture and one local world/wallet. Production SellPoint/FuelDeposit trigger methods are invoked explicitly with real prefab colliders, not physical trigger motion. Actual MoneyBag collection coroutine uses controlled PlayerInput hold. Missing-authority-binding retry temporarily selects the second peer context only for its synchronous request wrapper; no independent second world is claimed. Delayed feedback is a deterministic replay of an old collection revision. Wallet/save components are RAM-only and have automatic Start/saving disabled. No owner PlayerPrefs, SDK persistence, full game/recovery UI, independent rendered clients or Player Build. Authority takeover is not performed here; the separate264 fixture covers it. Ordinary offline sale/collection is left to a separate fixture.
